worked_solution:
Multiplying each row in the first matrix by each column in the second, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}CD & =[\begin{aligned}\frac{1}{2} & -\frac{3}{4} \\ 2 & \frac{1}{3}\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}-3 & \frac{5}{2} \\ 1 & 4\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}\frac{1}{2}\cdot (-3)+(-\frac{3}{4})\cdot 1\, & \,\frac{1}{2}\cdot \frac{5}{2}+(-\frac{3}{4})\cdot 4 \\ 2\cdot (-3)+\frac{1}{3}\cdot 1\, & \,2\cdot \frac{5}{2}+\frac{1}{3}\cdot 4\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}-\frac{3}{2}-\frac{3}{4}\, & \,\frac{5}{4}-3 \\ -6+\frac{1}{3}\, & \,5+\frac{4}{3}\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}-\frac{9}{4} & -\frac{7}{4} \\ -\frac{17}{3} & \frac{19}{3}\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$
